description.narrative: The Albania SDG Acceleration Fund advances the 2030 Agenda by accelerating progress towards achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Support is provided to SDG priority areas of the National Strategy for Development and Integration (2015-2020) and the Programme of Cooperation for Sustainable Development (2017-2021).
